verdict.rationale: Asana's own marketing describes in-product AI: pre-built AI agents that work inside workflows using Work Graph context, custom AI Teammates, and 'Asana Dash' billed as an AI Chief of Staff. Nothing explicitly documents insights or suggestions surfaced from the user's data inside the Asana UI. The MCP 'reports and summaries' capability runs in external assistants like Claude, so it is not in-product and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-product AI insights or suggestions (e.g., summaries, risk flags, recommendations) generated from workspace data, details on what Asana Dash surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Pre-built AI agents that work alongside your team inside real workflows, with shared memory, governance, and context from the Work Graph
Shared memory means AI Teammates learn from the work itself.
